title: docs(pm-dispatch): reading four skips an exempt same-seat claim
body:
Fixes #33845

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：席位开轮互斥的「读数四」从「首张带同席号 `Claim:` 卡」改为「首张带同席号且非豁免 `Claim:` 卡」，豁免席位留下的认领不再被当成前任的最后活动。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决（评论 6943066754，选 N14 分析 6897235004 的方案 A），只改这一处措辞。
- 风险与回滚：仅改 `.claude/` 下一份席位规则文档的一行，不涉及任何发布包或运行时代码；回滚即 revert 这一个 commit。
- 先看：`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` 第 10 行（唯一改动）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`，预期 seat-lifecycle.md 一行显示 `is 100 lines (ceiling 100; headroom 0)`，全绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及受管面 `.claude/**`，按其档位等审核记录后落地；保持 draft。

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md`, line 10 (reading four of the round-open mutex): the reading now takes the first closed card in the lane whose same-seat `Claim:` is not exempt, so an exempt seat's claim is no longer read as the predecessor's last activity. Wording inserted: 「且非豁免」. This executes the maintainer's ruling recorded in comment 6943066754, option A of analysis 6897235004 (N14).

## Tests

- None added or changed: the diff is one line of internal agent-skill prose and changes no tested behaviour; no ablation applies (configuration/docs class).

## Acceptance notes

- Line budget: the file stays 100 lines against ratchet ceiling 100 (one line changed, none added); line 10 measures 120 bytes, exactly the 120-byte line cap (108 bytes before). The ratchet row for this file is unchanged — no ceiling was raised.
- Premise re-checked on `origin/main` dc66d33082 before editing: line 10 was the reading-four line, 108 bytes; file 100 lines at ceiling 100.
- No changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing from any released package (`skip-changeset` rides this create).
